blocks.text: First, an excessive amount of primer (a sequence of 20 to 30 nucleotides) is mixed with the DNA fragment (gene of interest). This mixture of primers and DNA is heated to about 98°C. At this temperature, the double-stranded DNA breaks into single strands. Each single stranded DNA can act as the template for the in vitro DNA synthesis.
